proposal.rationale: NJ's Title 45, Chapter 1 is the umbrella statute for all professional/occupational licensing boards in the Division of Consumer Affairs. Many sections that previously went undetermined describe board-wide rules: § 45:1-2.2 governs "all members of the several professional boards and commissions"; § 45:1-3 references "the boards mentioned in section 45:1-2"; § 45:1-3.3 covers "administrative fees charged by boards" that are "uniform throughout all boards"; § 45:1-7 references "all professional or occupational licenses or certificates of registration"; § 45:1-7.5 applies to "a board" generally; §§ 45:1-7.6, 7.7, 7.10 reference "a professional or occupational licensing board within the Division of Consumer Affairs" or "any or all" such boards; § 45:1-7.8 applies to "a professional or occupational license" generally. Added narrow universal patterns to capture these board-wide phrases at chapter scope. § 45:1-9 (contractor-specific) genuinely lacks universal signals and remains undetermined, which is appropriate. Section cites in NJ are "45:1-N" form; chapter token is "1" between the colon and the dash.
